item.mng: baǰar arali neretü yeke dandr-a-yin qaγan
item.coloph: enedkeg-ün ubadini ka-ya-stu-a gay-a dhar-a-yin na-da kiged töbed-ün kelemürči sakyalig-ud-un ayaq-γ-a tegimlig belge bilig-tü orčiγulǰu nayiraγul-un orusiγulbai, mongγol-un kelen-dür kuunga odzer manǰusri bandita-dur dulduyidču, mati sagar-a sri badr-a toyin čorǰi orčiγulbai.

item.mng: bajar arali neretü yeke dandar-a-yin qaγan,
item.coloph: hindkeg-ün ubadini ka ya satu-a kay-a ḓhar-a-yin n-a ḍa kiged töbed-ün kelemürči sakyalig-ud-un / ayaγ-qa tegimlig belge bilig-tü orčiγulǰu nayiraγul-un orosiγulbai. mongγol-un kelen-tür küdga odser manǰusiri / bandida-tur dulduyidču, mati sagar-a srii badr-a toyin čorǰi orčiγulbai. , .
